package.name: lidar_icp_odometry
package.description: Point-to-Plane ICP LiDAR odometry on SE(3) — a practical implementation of scan-to-scan registration following SLAM Handbook Chapter 8 (LiDAR SLAM, §8.2). Demonstrates drift accumulation without loop closure, motivating full LiDAR SLAM (§8.4). Zero PCL dependency: voxel grid and normal estimation implemented from scratch in Eigen; KD-tree via vendored nanoflann single-header library.
